arithmetic: Exact fractions; angles in units of pi and squared norms in units of pi^2; no rounding.
coverage: Finite coefficient, periodicity and winding comparisons. General norm admissibility and curve-length identities have written proofs in note.tex.

dimension_family.scope: Equal angles 2/n and one winding shift.

family.scope: Three negative and five positive rational coefficients in each dimension.

fixed_dimension_obstruction.scope: Four radius margins per dimension, with the displayed constructive coefficient bound.

frobenius.scope: Five angles per coordinate in [-1,1], and winding integers -3 through 3, dimension two.

scalar_threshold.scope: Four positive coefficients; below, at, and above the scalar one-shift threshold.
